text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while watching Sakura Laurel's
dance lesson—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That should be good for the run-through.
I was mindful all the way to my fingertips, feeling great!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I see, I see... Keep awareness all the way to my fingertips, right!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Huh, Maya-chan!
Are you just watching instead of dancing today?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I'm studying Laurel-san's dance!
You see, Maya's practicing the same choreography, but—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm not mature like Laurel-san at all!
I want slender limbs and to dance gracefully too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: See, this doesn't feel mature at all~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...In that case, how about making the choreography
for this part cute instead?
Let's make it as cute as possible!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'll mix cute dance moves into a mature vibe
to create that charming gap!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: The contrast... might actually be great!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya wants this part to have
a super cute choreography~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Smiiiile♪
I'll show off my absolute peak cuteness!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Smiiiile♪
Let's finish off with a cute pose together!

text_block_list.name: Laurel & Mayano
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Nailed it perfectly!
As expected of you, Maya-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Right, right!?
Maya is mature and cute, after all☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, did I make your heart skip a beat, Trainer?
choice_data_list: It was so cute it took me by surprise!
I definitely felt a mature vibe from you too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "Because, Maya-chan! Let's keep this momentum going and become the ultimate cuties!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oooh~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The two continued their quest for the ultimate cute dance right until their studio time was up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oho, you really get it, Trainer!
Being cute is just another part of adult charm♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yep, exactly!
Maya understands totally!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, the two practiced a "mature yet cute dance" to play off the gap in their charms!
